items.why: A line of customer logos was added to the page; no pricing change.
Only a call-to-action link target changed; no pricing change.
Model Vault pricing moved from a per-instance rate by model and performance tier to a per-GPU hourly rate by GPU type, with a promotional rate through March 31 ‘27.

record.short: Model Vault moves from per-instance hourly rates ($3.00–$7.00) to per-GPU hourly rates ($3.00–$12.50).
record.headline: Cohere replaced Model Vault’s per-instance pricing (by model and performance tier) with a rate card per GPU type and replica count, and added a lower promotional hourly price through March 31 ‘27.
record.who: Customers buying dedicated Model Vault capacity; the bill now depends on the GPUs a model runs on and the number of replicas.
record.read: Pricing now follows the underlying hardware, which makes Cohere’s hosted models comparable with open-weight hosting and passes GPU cost changes straight through. Totals for a given workload can no longer be compared directly with the old per-instance rates.
record.caveat: The old and new units are not directly comparable, so no overall percentage change is given. Promotional prices apply through March 31 ‘27 and reserved capacity is quoted by sales.

items.why: Duplicated label text was cleaned up and a skip link added; plans, limits and prices are unchanged.
Two GPU rows that previously showed no price now show an hourly rate ($8.50 and $13.80 per GPU-hr).
AI Guard buttons changed from Request access to Start Free Trial and a menu item moved; prices are unchanged.

PD Reliability Platform included allowances were reset: Essential events fall from 40,000 to 25,000 and Starter seats from 10 to 5, while Ultimate AI actions rise from 100,000 to 160,000; platform fees are unchanged.

record.short: Platform fees are unchanged, but included allowances moved: Essential events 40,000 → 25,000, Ultimate AI actions 100,000 → 160,000.
record.headline: PagerDuty kept the $2,800 and $12,000 yearly platform fees but changed what each plan includes: fewer events on Essential and Ultimate, fewer seats on Starter, and more AI actions and seats on higher plans.
record.who: New buyers of the PD Reliability Platform plans. The page notes that plans bought before November 3, 2026 may have different entitlements.
record.read: The allowances behind the flat fee are being rebalanced: capacity moves from events toward seats and AI actions, which pushes buyers toward credit packs for event-heavy use. The limited-time AI action offer suggests PagerDuty wants to speed up AI adoption.
record.caveat: Events are now called Signal Intelligence Events. A limited-time bonus of 5 seats on Starter and free additional AI actions on Essential, Plus and Ultimate for the first year apply when signing by Jan 15, 2027.
